thread:
emma: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on the missing spans + bad aggregation. I outlined a concrete set of action items below — owners please ack and add ETAs. Postmortem doc: https://redwood.company/postmortems/1764289999-analytics-correctness

raj: Ack. I'll own the span backfill job and verification. Estimate: 2 days to validate, 3 days to backfill depending on cluster. @kai can you confirm infra for a one-off job? :+1:

kai: I can spin up a spot-G4 pool for the backfill. Need the job spec, expected row counts, and container image tag. Pinged eng-infra. cc @maria for the ETL changes you mentioned.

maria: I'll fix the aggregation logic in the ETL to address the double-counting and null parent_id edge case. Quick patch + unit tests today, deploy tomorrow. Also adding a regression test to CI to catch this going forward.

ops-bot: ALERT: trace ingestion backlog = 42,348 spans. ETL lag = 18m. Throttle policy currently active at 80% capacity.

emma: Action items (owners/due):
  1) Backfill + verification — owner: raj — due: 2026-03-25
  2) Aggregation patch + CI guard — owner: maria — due: 2026-03-24
  3) Infra for backfill (spot cluster, eviction protection) — owner: kai — due: 2026-03-24
  4) Follow-up doc and runbook updates (recurring pattern note) — owner: emma — due: 2026-03-30
Please update if any dates are unrealistic.

raj: Updated ticket with estimated rows and verification queries. Sample validation query I used:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM traces.raw_spans WHERE received_at BETWEEN '2026-03-22' AND '2026-03-23' AND service = 'ingest';
```
I'll run a dry-run tonight and post results.

maria: PR #4823 opened for aggregation fix, includes tests and changelog. Short description: handle null parent_id and correct batch windowing to prevent double-count. Requesting review from @kai and @emma.

kai: Infra request approved. Spinning up cluster now (spot-G4). ETA ~45m. Eviction protection enabled. @raj please share the job image tag so I can attach the proper IAM role.

emma: Thanks team. Let's do a sync in 2 hours in #incidents for status. Note: recording this as a potential recurring-pattern — monthly ingestion bursts have caused aggregation drift before. Long-term action: add monitoring alert for aggregation delta > 3% and a dashboard for current vs expected counts.

raj: Will add an integration test and an alert PR to the monitoring repo after the dry-run.

maria: Deployment went green. Aggregation discrepancy reduced from 6.2% -> 0.1% after the patch. Backfill dry-run looks clean. Will start the full backfill once raj confirms verification. :tada:
